summary.intent: Retire stale Phase 71 todos, fold new todos into Phase 72/73 scope, plan and execute Phase 72 (SDK write-plane durability/correctness) end-to-end, and along the way fix CI regressions and web-e2e flakiness that surfaced as blockers.
summary.outcome: Retired 8 addressed Phase 71 todos, fixed and merged two CI regression PRs (#600 web-e2e/sdk-e2e, #601 FUSE seq-equivocation), stabilized 4 flaky web-e2e tests, then planned and fully executed Phase 72 (10 plans across 7 waves, all 6 success criteria met), additionally fixing 113 pre-existing test-file TypeScript errors, wiring CI to typecheck tests, resolving 32 stale skipped tests, and discovering/fixing a real DoS-class unbounded-recursion bug in collectDescendantIpnsNames; phase verification and ship were still in progress at transcript end.

repo: This repo closes todos by deleting them from pending/ and adding a copy to completed/ (git mv), not via a separate resolved/ folder
ci-e2e.yml (Web E2E + Desktop E2E) only triggers on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch — never on PRs; use `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>` (not `-f ref=`) to validate a branch before merging
Dedicated desktop-e2e.yml/web-e2e.yml workflows accept a 'ref' dispatch input for pre-merge validation of a branch

playwright.config.ts ciFloor() raises wait timeouts to 60s only under CI (process.env.CI) — local runs use much tighter timeouts (15-30s), causing IPNS-gated mutation waits to flake locally even though they pass in CI
webServer.reuseExistingServer is `!process.env.CI`, so setting CI=1 locally to mirror CI's timeout floor breaks server reuse against an already-running stack

Root `pnpm typecheck` only runs each package's tsconfig.build.json (build) which excludes test files — test-file TypeScript errors were never caught in CI until this session added test-inclusive `tsc --noEmit` per package
@cipherbox/* packages resolve cross-package types via workspace symlinks to built dist (no path aliases/project references), so test-inclusive typecheck must run after build, in dependency order

dfsFindFolder in client.ts uses a `visited: Set<string>` guard against cyclic folder graphs; sibling function collectDescendantIpnsNames lacked this guard — a DoS-class unbounded-recursion gap now fixed

Many sdk test files carried `TODO(phase 63)`/`TODO(phase 65)` skip markers left over from Phase-62 type retirement (FileMetadata/FolderChild/FolderEntry/FolderMetadata → Node/SealedChildRef), overdue for migration by phase 72
moveItem was redesigned in a past phase to a zero-re-encryption link rewrite; an old skipped test asserting folderKey re-encryption behavior was obsolete and removed
Local `git commit` frequently times out/hangs on the 1Password SSH signing prompt but the commit lands anyway — always verify with git log/status rather than treating hook timeout as failure
GSD hook JSON fragments (plan:pre capability contributions) contain raw/multiline strings that break both `jq --raw` and naive JSON.parse — required a custom lenient parser

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on first-publish gated only by 'inode cid empty'; a dropped/stale UploadComplete retry re-sealed at seq=1 with a new CID, tripping Phase 71's anti-equivocation gate. Fixed by resolving IPNS first: NotFound→true first-publish, Found(seq)→route through publish_with_cas_retry with the resolved seq (avoiding a redundant second resolve per Greptile's P2 finding).

publish_with_cas_retry gained an optional preresolved_seq param so callers with an already-resolved sequence (from a Found guard) skip a second resolve round-trip; conflict-retry path still always re-resolves since a pre-resolved value is stale after a conflict.

dfsFindFolder threads a visited:Set<string> guard against cyclic folder graphs (returns null on repeat); collectDescendantIpnsNames lacked this guard, allowing unbounded recursion / DoS on a cyclic or malicious folder tree — fixed by adding the same guard at all 3 call sites.
ciFloor() helper raises wait timeouts under CI only (60s), while local runs use the caller's literal timeout (often 15-30s) — the source of most local-only flakes in IPNS-gated mutation waits.

workflow: When a background/dispatched validation run fails, diagnose per-OS/per-job before assuming the fix is wrong — infra failures (e.g. Windows postgres-setup) can be unrelated noise alongside genuine regressions

Verifying a fix locally against a flaky live-stack suite can be defeated by ambient degradation (load, cold cache) causing a different early test to flake and cascade/block the target tests each run — running under the CI-equivalent timeout regime (CI=1, with webServer reuse patched) is the reliable way to get a representative pass

Splitting a fix across the wrong branch (e.g. sdk-e2e Test 21 fix on a stray branch) is easy to correct by moving the edit to the intended PR branch and deleting the stray one, when the underlying file content is identical
Capture scope-creep discoveries (e.g. systemic TS drift, DoS bug) as durable todos/tasks immediately so they survive context compaction rather than being fixed ad hoc mid-flow
When user gives an autonomous 'plan→execute→ship' directive, stop asking clarifying questions and drive the whole flow with sensible defaults, escalating only for genuinely blocking ambiguity
Sequencing a cross-cutting hardening pass (test-typecheck fix + CI wiring) as the LAST plan in a phase avoids redoing it after each wave adds more test files

friction: Local web-e2e verification required 7 separate background runs (cold-stack flake, warm-stack repeat flake, 4.10 timeout bump, 4.11 same-class flake, ambient degradation at test 2.1, CI-regime attempt blocked by reuseExistingServer, final temp-patched CI-regime pass) before reaching a representative green result — took roughly an hour of iteration for what was ultimately a timeout-calibration issue
gh workflow run -f ref= returned HTTP 422 because the workflow definition on main predated the ref input; had to discover the --ref flag workaround
Initial check of the wrong todo directory (resolved/ instead of completed/) required a user correction mid-turn
GSD hook JSON fragments could not be parsed by jq --raw or naive JSON.parse due to embedded literal newlines/control chars in string values, requiring a hand-written lenient parser script
CI=1 locally conflicted with webServer.reuseExistingServer, requiring a temporary (reverted) playwright.config.ts patch just to get a CI-equivalent local run
git commit hung for 2 minutes on the 1Password SSH signing prompt multiple times during the session, requiring manual verification that commits had actually landed
Executor sandbox couldn't read .env in several sub-agent runs, deferring live sdk-e2e/web-e2e confirmation to the orchestrator/verification stage
